name: Byte
source:
You, housed by very old fashioned Victorian parents, are overdue for marriage. A party approaches, and you must push yourself out of your boundaries to find love! Or not; you could just make up an excuse to stay home...

[From [url=https://gayllotine.itch.io/byte]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的父母是非常老式的维多利亚时代父母，你早就该结婚了。一场派对即将来临，你必须突破自己的界限去寻找爱情！或不;你可以找个借口呆在家里…

[来自[url=https://gayllotine.itch.io/byte]Itch.io[/url]]
